'''Paolo's Chop Shop''' was a garage on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that bought stolen [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and dismantled them for parts. It was located in a rundown part of town near [[Nobadnobaya]], [[Xyx'w'zwQuqu]], [[Champio Muni]], [[New Vertica/Legends|New Vertica]], and the [[Red Sector]]. It was founded many years ago by a man named [[Paolo]] who died decades before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the chop shop was operated by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] named [[Zegundis]] and a male [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] named [[Ishtah]]. Following the birth of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] landed on Nar Shaddaa in [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous']] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']] so he could sell the ship and find passage to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He would sell the ship at Paolo's Chop Shop after a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] docking bay attendant named [[Shnozitskigante-maximilliana]] recommended it to him.
